title: What God has joined.
html_source: This ends the section in the style of Edward Gibbon which began with “The news was imparted.”

anchor.prefix: with which he was invested or in obedience to an inward voice, he delivered briefly and, as some thought, perfunctorily the ecclesiastical ordinance forbidding man to put asunder
anchor.suffix: But Malachias' tale began to freeze them with horror. He conjured up the scene before them. The secret panel beside the chimney slid back and in the recess appeared... Haines!
